description: This dataset compiles 20 human-observed occurrences of the fly species Physiphora alceae, sourced from the iNaturalist platform and aggregated via GBIF. The records span multiple countries, including the United States, Russia, and various European nations, with observations documented between 2017 and 2026. Each entry provides precise taxonomic classification, geographic coordinates, and temporal details such as the date of observation. The data includes quality metrics like coordinate uncertainty and is primarily licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0. Researchers can utilize this collection to analyze the global distribution patterns, seasonal activity, and habitat preferences of Physiphora alceae, supporting broader biodiversity monitoring and ecological studies.
